segments.name: Blank check company
segments.description: Blank check company seeking an initial business combination, expected to focus on biotechnology, healthcare and technology companies.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, management has determined that the Company only has one reporting segment.

revenueModel.text: Earns no operating revenue until a business combination; its income comes from interest and dividends on IPO trust proceeds.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company generates non-operating income in the form of interest income on cash and cash equivalents and dividend income from marketable securities from the proceeds derived from the Initial Public Offering.
